mentions.name: Low-touch task completion assistant (macOS)
mentions.description: A macOS app serving as a low-touch task completion assistant designed to counter distraction and hyper-habituation. Built with Swift and SwiftUI, with a family beta planned within weeks followed by a wider beta round in January.
mentions.problem: Counters distraction and hyper-habituation that get in the way of completing tasks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building my take on a low-touch task completion assistant designed to counter distraction and hyper-habituation.

It's starting off as a MacOS app because that's the machine I have.
